question: Can I customize the dimensions, wood finish, or fabric color for my space?
answer: Yes, absolutely! Bespoke customization is Pakwood's signature specialty. Every piece in our catalog can be tailored in length, seating depth, wood polish (Natural Amber, Walnut, Smoked Teak, Matte Espresso), and upholstery fabric (Turkish Velvet, Heavyweight Bouclé, Italian Leatherite). You can also provide your room blueprint or photos directly on WhatsApp (03217324620), and our design team will provide 3D sizing advice free of charge.

question: What is Pakwood's advance payment policy and order confirmation process?
answer: To initiate handcrafted production in our Multan workshop, we require an initial 70% advance deposit via online bank transfer (Meezan Bank, HBL, or Alfalah). Once your furniture is completed, our workshop master records detailed high-definition 360-degree video walkthroughs and close-up photos of your finished piece, sent directly to your WhatsApp. The remaining 30% balance is cleared upon your satisfaction prior to white-glove dispatch.

question: How long does production take, and how is furniture delivered across Pakistan?
answer: Standard production lead time is 10 to 14 working days for individual pieces and 15 to 18 working days for complete bedroom suites or custom dining sets. We dispatch nationwide using specialized furniture freight logistics (with heavy-gauge wooden crating and protective foam wrap) covering Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Karachi, Faisalabad, Peshawar, Multan, Sialkot, and all major cities. In major metropolitan areas, white-glove room placement and assembly service is available.

question: What wood types do you use, and do you offer a structural warranty?
answer: We exclusively build structural skeletons from kiln-dried solid Pakistani Kikar hardwood and hand-selected seasoned Multani Sheesham (Dalbergia sissoo / Rosewood). All timber undergoes rigorous chemical vacuum treatment against termites and wood borers, followed by moisture-chamber kiln drying to 8-10% equilibrium. Every Pakwood piece includes an official 10-Year Structural Timber & Frame Warranty.

question: Can I visit the Pakwood workshop or showroom in Multan?
answer: We warmly welcome all patrons to visit our workshop and gallery near Hussain Agahi Market in Multan. You can inspect raw seasoned Sheesham logs, touch fabric swatch cards, observe our master joinery artisans at work, and discuss your interior blueprints over traditional Multani tea. Simply message us on WhatsApp (03217324620) ahead of time to coordinate a dedicated consultation.
